body:
## Pull request overview This PR introduces a global switch for Z3 parallelization (enabled by default) and extends the extension schema/docs pipeline to support a new `nonstandard-released` state with a `release_date`, including updating `Xqci` to use a stable revdate. **Changes:** - Add `Udb.global_options.parallel_z3` and plumb it into `Z3Solver` initialization, plus a CLI flag to control it. - Extend extension version data model + schema for `release_date` and update doc generation helpers/state text for `nonstandard-released`. - Update `Xqci.yaml` version metadata to use `nonstandard-released` with a fixed `release_date`. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 8 out of 10 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | tools/ruby-gems/udb/lib/udb/z3.rb | Configure Z3 `parallel.enable` globally per solver creation based on `Udb.global_options`. | | tools/ruby-gems/udb/lib/udb/obj/extension.rb | Add `release_date` accessor to `ExtensionVersion`. | | tools/ruby-gems/udb/lib/udb/global_opts.rb | New global options struct (default Z3 parallelization enabled). | | tools/ruby-gems/udb/lib/udb/cli.rb | Add `--[no-]z3parallel` flag and set global option. | | tools/ruby-gems/udb-gen/sorbet/rbi/gems/udb@0.1.3.rbi | Update RBI to reflect new API surface (but currently has issues). | | tools/ruby-gems/udb-gen/lib/udb-gen/generators/ext_doc/helpers.rb | Use `release_date` for revdate when `nonstandard-released`. | | tools/ruby-gems/udb-gen/lib/udb-gen/adoc_helpers.rb | Add doc strings for `nonstandard-released` state. | | spec/schemas/ext_schema.json | Require `release_date` for `nonstandard-released` and define its schema. | | spec/custom/isa/qc_iu/ext/Xqci.yaml | Mark version `0.13.0` as `nonstandard-released` with a `release_date`. |
